Use an agent constructed without `proxyEnv` for these configurations. Plain subclasses are still supported, and public type signatures are unchanged. (**#11243**)

changes.change: **Header Defaults:** Only plain objects, null-prototype maps, and compatible `AxiosHeaders` instances are treated as common or method-specific defaults; literal headers such as `Link` are now preserved. Applications using custom class instances as defaults must convert them to plain maps, for example `{ post: { ...customDefaults } }`, or compatible `AxiosHeaders`. Otherwise, those instances become literal header values, including on requests using other methods. (__[#11156](https://github.com/axios/axios/pull/11156)__)

changes.change: Header Types: TypeScript now rejects header values that are Promises, functions, or objects with custom toString() methods. Resolve promises, call functions, or explicitly convert objects before assigning header values. Supported scalar, array, and grouped headers remain available. (#11209)

changes.change: **Header Injection & Proxy Bypass:** Backports v1 security hardening — sanitizes outgoing header values to strip invalid bytes, CRLF sequences, and boundary whitespace (including array values); adds proper `NO_PROXY`/`no_proxy` enforcement covering wildcards, explicit ports, loopback aliases (`localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, `::1`), bracketed IPv6, and trailing-dot hostnames. Proxy bypass is now checked before the proxy URL is parsed, and `parsed.host` is used for correct port and IPv6 handling. (__#10688__)
changes.excerpt: **Header Injection & Proxy Bypass:** Backports v1 security hardening — sanitizes outgoing header values to strip invalid bytes, CRLF sequences, and boundary whitespace (including array values); adds proper `NO_PROXY`/`no_proxy` enforcement covering wildcards, explicit ports, loopback aliases (`localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, `::1`), bracketed IPv6, and trailing-dot hostnames. Proxy bypass is now checked before the proxy URL is parsed, and `parsed.host` is used for correct port and IPv6 handling. (__#10688__)
